_README: THE TARGET LIST — the indicators we are committing to make draw identically.
Run:  cd app && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run \
Paths resolve relative to the REPO ROOT, or may be absolute.
A path that does not exist FAILS the run rather than being skipped — a target
list that quietly drops entries is a list that lies about coverage.
⛔ Do NOT commit a licence-bearing third-party script into this repo. It is
PUBLIC. Park the file outside it (e.g. C:/Users/Patrick/uct-pine-local/) and
point at it by absolute path — the report reads it, the repo never holds it.
⭐ THE CORPUS ENTRIES BELOW ARE A STAND-IN, CHOSEN FOR SPREAD, NOT A WISH
LIST. They were picked to span capability classes — plain plots, bands,
pivots, VWAP, CVD/MTF, drawing objects, SMC/UDT, matrix — so the report shows
a DISTRIBUTION of blockers rather than one blocker repeated fifteen times.
Swap in the indicators actually wanted and the queue re-orders itself.
